items.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
items.dek: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

items.title: US 'watching closely' after plague researcher dies in Russia, Rubio says
items.dek: The US says it is monitoring the case of a lab technician who died at a plague research centre in Siberia.
